remediation.reason: Scoped review failed: anti-tampering checks misgrade honest runs; simplify the grader to the honest-agent threat model

findings.summary: isHarnessBookkeeping omits .ways/memory/, so canonical discovery completion and memory commits outside the implement window are flagged eval-change-outside-implement and honest D runs grade non-compliant, breaking AC1 and AC4.
divergentPaths ignores .gitignore, so ignored local tool files (e.g. per-user settings, caches) grade honest real runs non-compliant.
The full-sdd initial prefix demands certifying through close while the resume task asks to stop, and the resume prefix assumes an active work.
A full-sdd task failing before grading records compliance applicable:false, shown as compliant:null in compare while counted in the denominator.
Command adapter runs are always evidence.kind real, consistent with spec decision 2.
Deliberate Git subversion by an agent with unrestricted shell is beyond local verification; out of scope under the honest-agent threat model.
